description: Resource Type definition for AWS::CloudWatch::View. A view is a named, reusable SQL query that can be referenced from CloudWatch telemetry queries. View names must be unique within the account and region.

Name.description: The name of the view. Must begin with the "view." prefix followed by lowercase alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores. View names must be unique within the account and region. If not specified, a name is generated.
